params.negative_prompt: music, melody, voice, speech, crowd, birds, wind

stack-block-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a stone block is set on top of a wall block: a solid stone-on-stone tap, higher and lighter than a floor placement, one hit.

stack-block-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a wooden block is stacked onto another wooden block: a short hollow wooden knock, one hit.

place-gun-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a small iron cannon on a wooden carriage is set down on stone: a heavy wooden thump with a short iron ring, one hit.

place-gun-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a heavy cast-iron object is placed on a stone floor: a dull deep clunk and a brief metallic ring.

fuse-heavy-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. four small iron cannons clatter together and lock into one big cannon: a quick metallic clatter, then a deep iron clunk, then a short satisfying ring.

fuse-heavy-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. heavy metal parts slide and lock into place: a short grind, a deep clunk and a ring, mechanical and solid.

rotate-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a wooden game piece is turned a quarter turn on a board: a tiny wooden tick, very short.

rotate-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a wooden knob clicks one notch: a short crisp wooden click.

ring-closed-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a short bright rising chime of three wooden xylophone notes, cheerful, a success in a board game.

ring-closed-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a quick rising glockenspiel arpeggio with a soft wooden tap at the end, a small win, one second.

horn-build-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a small harbour bell rings twice, warm and soft, announcing a calm phase.

horn-build-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a gentle wooden whistle plays two falling notes, like a boatswain's call, calm.

burn-outside-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a small wooden structure burns up quickly: a short crackle of fire and a soft puff of smoke, over in a second.

burn-outside-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a brief whoosh of flame and a crackle, a tiny thing catching fire and going out, no explosion.

hit-ground-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. an iron cannonball lands on soft earth: a dull heavy thud with a puff of dirt, no crack, short.

hit-ground-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a heavy iron ball drops onto grass and dirt: a low thump and a scatter of soil, short.

hit-ship-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. an iron cannonball hits the wooden hull of a small sailing ship: a hard wooden crack, splintering and a creak, short.

hit-ship-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. wood splinters as a cannonball strikes a ship's planks: a sharp crack and a wooden creak, dry.

loading-ready-a.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a bright short wooden chime of two rising xylophone notes, a ready signal in a board game.

loading-ready-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a crisp short bell ding with a wooden tap, a ready signal, half a second.

hit-wall-c.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. an iron cannonball strikes a stone castle wall: a hard stone crack with a puff of dust and a small chip of stone falling, dry, short.

hit-water-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a cannonball drops into the sea: a deep plunk and a splash with droplets, short.

draw-piece-b.prompt: Game sound effect, dry, close, no music, no voice, no ambience. a wooden game piece is pulled from a cloth bag and set in a tray: a soft rustle and a wooden tap.
